\\b(?:void|int|uint|short|ushort|char|long|byte|uint8_t|uint16_t|uint32_t|int32_t)\\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\s*\\([^;{]*\\)\\s*\\{

○ Match the string "ushort".
○ Match the string "char".
○ Match the string "long".
○ Match the string "byte".
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match the string "uint".
○ Match with 3 alternative expressions.
○ Match the string "8_t".
○ Match the string "16_t".
○ Match the string "32_t".
○ Match the string "int32_t".
○ Match a whitespace character atomically at least once.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically any number of times.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '('.
○ Match a character in the set [^;{] greedily any number of times.
○ Match ')'.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '{'.
